scripts.typecheck: cd ../.. && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} restore --project server && cd packages/server && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: cd ../.. && rm -rf packages/server/generated/bin/Release/net10.0/linux-x64 packages/server/generated/obj/Release/net10.0/linux-x64 && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} restore --project server && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} generate --project server && dotnet publish packages/server/generated/tsonic.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 -o packages/server/generated/bin/Release/net10.0/linux-x64
scripts.dev: cd ../.. && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} restore --project server && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} generate --project server && ${TSONIC_BIN:-tsonic} run --no-generate --project server
